name: Form Studio
scope: Create editable geometry, explore materials, and save a Form project in the browser.
limits: Native geometry, simulation, filesystem integration and rendering differ from the web edition. Browser work is not certification for manufacturing, engineering or garment fit.

name: Luma Studio
scope: Paint, compose with layers, adjust color, and export an image using the shared Luma editing engine.
limits: Native RAW codecs and desktop print features are not all available in the browser. Optional hosted generative edits require sign-in and send selected image content to a service. PSD conversions have limits.

name: Ghost Studio
scope: Add photos, adjust a garment or object study, and export a GLB or editable project using the real Ghost web app.
limits: Local silhouette and template methods create visual approximations. They do not recover exact patterns or calibrated fit. Recovery belongs to this browser; export a portable backup.

name: ScenePilot
scope: Try the existing Browser Lite editor with your own media and a beat-aware edit.
limits: Desktop Pro adds native media processing, inference and delivery features. Browser decoding and export depend on available codecs and memory. Native release qualification is incomplete; Intel is unqualified.

name: Librarian
scope: Import your PDFs, read them, build a shelf, and search connected book catalogs.
limits: Catalog search needs a network connection and depends on each source. AI features may send questions and shelf context to the service. Browser storage can be cleared or evicted; retain your original files.

name: Reclaim
scope: Inspect files you select, find identical copies by content, sort large files, and export a review report.
limits: This read-only browser companion cannot scan your whole Mac, clear caches, quarantine or delete files. It is a scoped testing experience for file review, not the native cleanup engine.

name: Sattari StemDeck
scope: Use Library, Perform, Arrange and Mixer views in StemDeck Online. Mix decks, arrange audio and MIDI, add built-in effects, capture input and save a portable project.
limits: Arrangement playback is marked as a preview in the current Sattari studio. Browser effects are distinct from native plugin hosting. Track-stem export is not AI stem separation. Save a portable .sattari backup to keep your source audio with your session.

name: Bounce
scope: Play your audio, search a local queue, adjust EQ, and save a playlist in this browser.
limits: Browser codecs determine which files play. Files and playlists stay in this browser; storage may be cleared. This companion does not include the native tag reader, desktop audio engine or a streaming catalog.
